confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on several 2026 cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, Expatistan, Numbeo-based guides) that disagree by source and date, so they are ballpark. Beer is taken as a bar or restaurant draught (CHF 7.5 to 8), not the much cheaper supermarket bottle. Cocktail uses one Expatistan downtown-club data point (about CHF 15 to 17) and wine uses the beer-relative basis. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bern's hotel and hostel market, not checked against live listings, and are the least certain values. USD figures assume roughly 1 CHF = 1.25 USD. FX: I could not open an official RBA page with a verified recent rate. The value given is the 20 March 2026 observation shown on the RBA exchange-rates overview page, which is stale. A later secondary report cites an RBA 4pm reference of 0.6976 for 3 November 2026, but I did not verify it on rba.gov.au, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Switzerland-wide cost levels with Bern about 7% above the national average per MyLifeElsewhere; no separate comparable city was needed.
